Rachel P (CS): quick sync for Hawthorne private/VPC onboarding. blockers: app subnets can't reach our collectors, KMS key doesn't include Redwood role, and Splunk shows no events. compliance demo Friday — need owners + ETAs.
Marco G (Network): taking egress. their app RT had only TGW targets; no NAT in app AZs. ask Hawthorne to provision NAT per-AZ or we can temp-route to our egress appliance. which do you prefer?
hawthorne-pm: prefer temp route to your appliance for faster cutover. we can revert later. provisioning change on our side now.
Marco G (Network): OK i'll push a small route update: 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-egress-zz. ETA 20m.
Iris V (Security): KMS: key policy currently admin-only. they need to add our cross-account role ARN: arn:aws:iam::444333222111:role/redwood-inference with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. sent snippet to PM.
Sam O (Ops): i'll watch the forwarder and be ready to reload after route. if logs still missing i'll tail and capture HEC errors.
deploy-bot: change scheduled 7382000030: apply-temp-egress-route-hawthorne (auto-approve).
Marco G (Network): route applied at 7382000035; verified tcp 443 to collector from app instance -> 200.
hawthorne-sre: updated KMS policy at 7382000042 and rotated Splunk HEC token earlier; pushing token to your vault now.
Sam O (Ops): forwarder showed `403 HEC token invalid` between 7382000040-7382000046. reloaded with new token at 7382000048; events resumed at 7382000050. small ingestion gap ~10s.
Iris V (Security): ran KMS decrypt test at 7382000054 — success. KMS signoff complete.
Rachel P (CS): capture 10s ingestion gap for compliance note and offer a replay for audit evidence. marking renewal risk as "monitor"; will escalate to "watch" if anything else slips before Friday. action items: Net/Ops confirm egress + forwarder (done), Sec confirm KMS signoff (done), CS to send remediation summary and replay offer. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
